clauses.requirement: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and that component is in its normal position(s) of use, the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with UN R48. For dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps this is satisfied if, after moving the component and returning it to the normal position 10 times, no measured angular inclination of the lamp relative to its support differs by more than 0.15 per cent from the average of the 10 values; if this value is exceeded, each limit in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1 shall be modified by the excess to reduce the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.

The apparent surface, in the direction of the reference axis, of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component (with or without a light-signalling device on it) in any fixed position different from the normal position of use; a fixed position means the stable or natural rest position(s) of the movable component specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not; if this is not practicable, the alternatives in paragraphs 5.21.1 and 5.21.2 apply.

If the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the front/rear position lamps, direction-indicator lamps or retro-reflectors is more than 50 per cent hidden by a movable component in a fixed position other than the normal position of use, additional lamps satisfying all position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps shall be switched ON (alternative to paragraph 5.21.2).

As the alternative where hiding of no more than 50 per cent is not practicable, a remark in the communication form (item 10.1 of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components; and a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the vehicle's presence on the road, for example by a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements.
Paragraph 5.21.2 (communication form remark and in-vehicle user notice) does not apply to retro-reflectors.
With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp, even bearing an approval mark, is deemed not present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.

Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except where those are used as non-replaceable light sources as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2, shall be fitted so the light source can be correctly replaced without expert assistance and without special tools other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer; the vehicle manufacturer shall provide a detailed description of the replacement procedure with the vehicle.

Where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, that light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23 (without expert assistance or special tools other than those provided by the manufacturer, with a detailed replacement procedure supplied).
